title: Tool Over-Temperature
shortDescription: Nuron 22V tool too hot to operate.
fullDescription: Hilti Nuron 22V SF/SID tools light service indicator red once per cycle when motor or driver thermal limit reached.

fixSteps.title: Cool
fixSteps.instruction: Wait 15 min, run no-load 10s to test.

title: Battery Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Two red service blinks indicate B22 Nuron pack over the discharge temperature limit.

fixSteps.title: Swap pack
fixSteps.instruction: Use cool B22 pack; let other recover 20 min.

faq.a: Yes Hilti Connect app shows pack temp.

title: Over-Current Stall
shortDescription: Tool stalled and protection cut current.
fullDescription: Three blinks indicate the AVR/ATC or motor over-current protection tripped.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Release trigger 3s, restart with side handle.

faq.a: Active Torque Control auto-cuts on jam.

title: Battery Communication Error
fullDescription: Yellow service indicator with one blink indicates Nuron pack data not received by tool.

title: Battery Discharged
fullDescription: Two yellow blinks indicate the pack is depleted; charge before further use.

title: Motor / Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Steady red service indicator means rotor position sensors failed; tool requires service.

fixSteps.title: Hilti service
fixSteps.instruction: Use Hilti tool drop-off or pickup service.

videoSearchQuery: Hilti Nuron service indicator solid red

title: Drop Detection Lockout
fullDescription: Combined red and yellow flashing indicates the Nuron drop sensor recorded a free-fall event.

fixSteps.title: Reinsert pack
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and reinsert B22, inspect tool.

title: Charger Defective Pack
fullDescription: Solid red on C4-22 means BMS lockout or cell imbalance detected.

title: Charger Temperature Hold
shortDescription: Pack out of charge temperature window.
fullDescription: Yellow blink on C4-22 charger as it waits for B22 to reach safe temperature.

title: Hilti Connect BLE Sync Error
shortDescription: Tool not pairing with Hilti Connect app.
fullDescription: Nuron tools include BLE telemetry. App reports sync error when tool BLE module fails advertising.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Bring app within 1m of tool, install latest tool firmware via Connect.

title: Nuron Connect fail
fullDescription: Nuron Connect pair failure. Common indication on Hilti cordless tools. Resolve by power-cycling, checking battery contacts, or contacting service.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean battery and tool contacts with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test on another tool
fixSteps.instruction: Try battery in another compatible tool to isolate.

whenToCallPro: If reset doesn't fix or BMS continues to trip, warranty service may be needed.

faq.a: Maybe — try another known-good battery first.
Most cordless platforms have 3-year battery warranty.
